title: Multi-Fidelity Training Reshapes Uncertainty Decomposition in Atomistic Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-fidelity training, which combines abundant low-fidelity data with scarce high-fidelity labels, is increasingly common in atomistic modeling, but its effect on predictive uncertainty remains largely unexplored. We investigate this question using deep ensembles of mean-variance MACE models trained on ANI-1x, contrasting high-fidelity training from scratch with low-fidelity pretraining followed by fine-tuning. We characterize aleatoric, epistemic, and total uncertainty throughout training and under two distribution shifts: unseen molecular systems and higher-energy configurations. We find that pretraining reduces prediction error and improves uncertainty-based ranking across all test sets, but does not yield well-calibrated predictive variances; calibration deteriorates more severely under energy extrapolation. translated_title: 多保真度训练重塑原子模型中的不确定性分解
translated_abstract: 多保真度训练（即将丰富的低保真度数据与稀缺的高保真度标签相结合）在原子建模中日益普遍，但其对预测不确定性的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们使用在ANI-1x数据集上训练的均值-方差MACE模型深度集成来研究这一问题，对比了从零开始的高保真度训练与低保真度预训练加微调两种策略。我们在整个训练过程中以及在两种分布偏移（未见过的分子系统和更高能量构型）下，对偶然不确定性、认知不确定性和总不确定性进行了表征。我们发现，预训练降低了预测误差，并在所有测试集上改善了基于不确定性的排序能力，但并不能产生良好校准的预测方差；在能量外推情形下，校准恶化更为严重。训练动力学分析将大部分校准退化定位于高保真度优化阶段，在此期间……
tldr: 该研究利用均值-方差MACE模型深度集成发现，多保真度训练中低保真度预训练虽能降低预测误差并改善不确定性排序，但预测方差的校准退化主要发生在高保真度微调阶段，且在能量外推下更为严重。
en_tdlr: Using deep ensembles of mean-variance MACE models, this study reveals that in multi-fidelity training, low-fidelity pretraining reduces prediction error and improves uncertainty-based ranking, but most of the predictive variance calibration degradation occurs during high-fidelity fine-tuning and worsens under energy extrapolation.
